name: Priya Sharma
before: 7-year career break after marriage and relocation
after: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft India
story: After relocating from Mumbai to Noida for my husband's job, I left my software engineering career. Seven years later, with two children and rusty skills, I uploaded my resume to NayiUdaan. The AI found that my core skills were still strong and created a focused 8-week plan. Week by week, I rebuilt my Python, practiced system design, and used the AI interview coach. Microsoft's returnship programme was the final step.

name: Rekha Mishra
story: I was 32, had no education beyond 8th class, and my husband said there was no future for me in business. I found NayiUdaan through a local NGO partner. I took the tailoring course and the financial literacy course. With a ₹50,000 micro-loan from a partner SHG, I started with a single machine. Today I employ 8 women from my village.

name: Fatima Shaikh
before: Domestic violence survivor, no income, 3 children
after: Independent data entry professional with stable income
story: When I left my abusive marriage, I had nothing — no money, no skills, three children under 10. A legal aid partner connected me to NayiUdaan. I learned basic computers and data entry in 3 weeks. The platform connected me to my first job at a small accounting firm. Today I am fully financially independent and my children are in school.

name: Ananya Krishnamurthy
after: Data Science Lead at a health-tech startup
story: Leaving my data scientist role to care for my mother felt like the end of everything I had built. The gap in my resume felt impossible to explain. NayiUdaan reframed the narrative — the platform's AI showed recruiters exactly how my skills were still relevant, and connected me with three startups that valued diverse experience. I joined a health-tech company that was inspired by stories like mine.
